output.reason: [ev-f3d6519c3794] only says that Traefik v3 no longer supports the `networking.k8s.io/v1beta1` Ingress API group and that operators should use `networking.k8s.io/v1`. It does not say what happens to an exposed environment. It does not say whether Ingress objects created as v1beta1 stop being processed or are ignored, or whether Traefik fails against clusters that serve only v1beta1. The section context adds nothing beyond this one item. The proposed setting-ignored statement ("will no longer be recognized or processed") is therefore an inference that would create mandatory work. To decide, we need upstream text or an artifact showing how Traefik v3 handles v1beta1 Ingress objects or clusters that serve only v1beta1.
